articles.title: Japan’s defense chief visits shrine neighbors see as symbol of Japanese militarism - AP News
articles.description: Japanese Defense Minister Shinjiro Koizumi has prayed at Tokyo’s controversial Yasukuni Shrine, seen by Japan’s Asian neighbors as a symbol of the country’s past militarism. Koizumi has been a regular at the shrine. Visits by Japanese politicians to the shrin…
